style_image.usage_description: Actual approved Rattlebones is rendering authority ONLY: hard native pixels, chunky contours, connected light/shadow clusters, economical texture. Do NOT copy skeleton, face, crown, anatomy or character palette. Target is violet dungeon masonry.

request.description: Native pixel-art sprite sheet containing exactly TWO SEPARATE MATCHING DUNGEON SIDE-MASONRY BUTTRESSES, left and right versions, each roughly 48px wide and 120px tall with transparent gap between. 2D straight-on SIDE-SCROLLER frontal view, flat backdrop framing pieces, NOT isometric. Left piece has a straight vertical outer LEFT edge and an irregular inward RIGHT edge that widens in broad chunky stone steps near the bottom; right piece has straight outer RIGHT edge and inward LEFT edge. Both upper halves narrow about20px, lower halves widen gradually to46px like old castle wall corner masonry hugging the sides of a bottom HUD. Several courses of large simple rectangular and subtly chipped violet stone blocks, staggered brick joints, darker narrow cracks. Three or four broad matte stone tones, cool dark charcoal-purple shadows and muted lavender top-left edge highlights; use lighting from top-left on BOTH pieces. Thick broad foundation stones at the bottom are natural masonry, NOT classical pillar plinths or capitals. Ends are complete with2px transparent margin, no cropped bricks, no loose debris. Keep center empty for UI. Clean coherent silhouettes, slight chunky irregularity, small selective edge chips only. No skinny ornamental columns, no frames, gems, UI, skulls, banners, torches, characters, doors, glowing magic, background wall, painterly detail, blurry AA, dithering or noisy scratches. Treat this as two individual modular environment sprites, NOT a full scene.
